emails.subject: Parshwanath Capital Ventures Fund | Pre-IPO & Anchor interest – Ekkaa Electronics (India) Limited
emails.text:
Dear Ritu Sharma and Vaibhav Shah,

I am CA Deep Dalal, Fund Manager of Parshwanath Capital Ventures Fund. I am writing to you as the Book Running Lead Manager to the proposed IPO of Ekkaa Electronics (India) Limited, whose Draft Red Herring Prospectus dated September 24, 2026 has been filed with SEBI for listing on the Main Board of BSE and NSE.

ABOUT US
Parshwanath Capital Ventures Fund is a SEBI-registered Category III Alternative Investment Fund focused on India's primary markets. We invest through Pre-IPO placements, IPO Anchor Investor books, the QIB portion of IPOs and Qualified Institutional Placements (QIPs), working closely with promoters and merchant bankers through the listing journey.

OUR VIEW ON EKKAA ELECTRONICS (INDIA)
Ekkaa Electronics (India) is an integrated original design manufacturer and original equipment manufacturer of consumer electronics and appliances in India, with significant presence in India’s consumer electronics and appliance manufacturing ecosystem. We have studied the DRHP closely, and the business and its growth trajectory fit well with our investment focus.

Key financials (restated, ₹ crore unless stated)
                                       FY26       FY25       FY24
Revenue from operations (₹ cr)        1,222     496.51       0.07
Growth (YoY)                         146.1%  699215.5%          –
EBITDA (₹ cr)                        114.53      55.40      -0.41
EBITDA margin                          9.4%      11.2%    -574.6%
Profit after tax (₹ cr)               65.38      23.55      -4.05
PAT margin                             5.4%       4.7%   -5704.2%
Net worth (₹ cr)                     251.53      38.22      14.67
Return on net worth                   26.0%      61.6%     -27.6%
Debt / Equity                         1.23x      8.44x     11.57x
Source: restated financial information in the DRHP; EBITDA and ratios computed from it.

HOW WE WOULD LIKE TO PARTICIPATE
  1. Pre-IPO placement: The DRHP contemplates a Pre-IPO Placement of up to 20% of the Fresh Issue. We would be keen to participate in this round.
  2. Anchor Investor portion: As a SEBI-registered Category III AIF, we qualify as a QIB and would like to be considered for the anchor book.
  3. QIB portion: We would also look to participate in the QIB portion of the IPO.

FUND PROFILE
View our fund profile (PDF): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1yQX3TH3nmyqzt6rICyliVYFCP1okKqVv/view?usp=sharing (also attached)

I would be grateful if you could introduce us to the promoters of Ekkaa Electronics (India) (Sagar Gupta, Chandra Prakash Gupta and Madhuri Gupta) and keep us informed as the pre-IPO and anchor book discussions progress. A short call at your convenience would be much appreciated.

I look forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,

CA Deep Dalal
Fund Manager, Parshwanath Capital Ventures Fund
SEBI-registered Category III AIF
Email: fundmanager@parshwanath.in
